narrative.details: It is very kind of you to offer to help me again champion. It looks like we've collected $2082w silk bandages, so we'll need more.
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 silk bandages to Nurse Stonefield at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You are such a selfless person. Thank you very much for your contribution to the war effort. It's people like you that are going to make the difference between success and failure at Ahn'Qiraj. I just hope that all of this will be enough.

Thanks again, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: It is very kind of you to offer to help me again, champion. It looks like we've collected a goodly number of the silk bandages we've been tasked with, but we still need more. adventurer, is there any way that you could see fit to put together another bundle and return them to me here? The Alliance and I will be most grateful.
